name: dsh-minigames

one_liner.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可拖动浮窗和 99 款离线小游戏。
one_liner.en: A draggable floating panel with 99 offline games for DSH Web.

external_services.purpose: 读取版本及兼容性数据
查询发布标签并作为安装来源

local: 需要 DSH Web 和浏览器 DOM/Canvas；小游戏逻辑在浏览器本地运行。
使用 localStorage 保存窗口状态、当前游戏和各游戏最高分。
Web 服务注册版本查询与用户点击更新端点；更新会调用 pnpm 安装插件。

skipped: Remaining individual game implementations under src/client/games/* (99 games are registered; representative modules and registry were read).
Remaining per-game tests under tests/* (105 test files are recorded in extracted facts; registry test was read).

readme_mismatch: README describes 18 built-in games and presents an 18-game roster; src/client/games/index.ts registers 99 built-ins and tests/registry.spec.ts checks the 99-game count. The larger current registry is the code-backed capability count.

completeness.reason: The panel lifecycle, game picker, persistence, and 99-game registry are implemented; representative game logic is present.

code.reason: Typed game interfaces and separate pure logic/render modules support the panel; lifecycle cleanup and duplicate registration are explicit.

docs.reason: README explains installation, interaction, compatibility, and game controls, though its game roster is stale versus source.

maintenance.reason: The list records 481 commits and a push on 2026-11-05, shortly before this analysis.

tests.reason: Facts report 105 test files; registry tests assert built-in game registration and lookup behavior.

quality.notes: Scores use repository source and list metadata; all 99 game implementations were not individually reviewed.
